findings.text: the negative control restores `figure_rows`' three `rglob` calls, whose added syscalls are directory scans proportional to the number of directories under `figures/`, not to covered files, so on the fixture §23 declares ("at least 2,000 files, plans and figures together", layout unstated) the control may not move the per-covered-file count to the 1.5 bound at all — measured on a 2,000-covered-file tree: 0.153 added calls per covered file with 10 figures per directory (306 `scandir` over 50 figure directories) against 1.503 with one figure per directory (3,006 `scandir` over 500), a tenfold swing at the same file count, while the walk's own cost is 0.084 and 0.308 per covered file respectively
